outages.description: A failure on Peru's national power grid cut electricity across northern Peru on November 1, impacting Internet traffic in Piura starting around 19:45 UTC (14:45 local).
A transmission line trip on the national grid caused a significant drop in Internet traffic across coastal Demerara and Berbice.
Damage to two international fiber optic links on Route Nationale 1 caused a complete outage on Digicel Haiti (AS27653)
A reported drone strike on the Luhansk Telephone Company building caused a complete outage of Internet traffic from LTC (AS29031).
